relation.existence: a common c exists iff the two candidate bases agree and c>0, c!=1
relation.uniqueness: when a,x are fixed with a>0 and x!=0, the compatible positive base c is unique; the same must be obtained from b,y

codec_semantics.decode: ab=c^z; canonical prime factorization recovers the prime multiset; fixed c maps each prime back to its log coordinate

prime_domain.distinct_primes_imply_log_ratio_irration: for distinct primes a,b, ln(a)/ln(b) is irrational; therefore x/y is irrational under any common valid base
prime_domain.factorization_role: unique recovery of the unordered prime constituents from ab

three_system_use.purpose: make the shared log base an explicit compatibility parameter for UFAL/Log-Abelian certificates
